jobDescription:
Data Engineer

Location: Berlin, Germany / Hybrid
Employment: Full-time

About the Role
We are building our data platform and need a Data Engineer to design and operate production data pipelines that feed analytics and ML across the company.

Key Responsibilities
- Build and operate batch and streaming data pipelines in production.
- Model and maintain the data warehouse.
- Own data quality, monitoring, and pipeline reliability.
- Work with large-scale distributed processing.
- Partner with analysts and data scientists on data availability.

Required Skills
- 3+ years building production data pipelines
- Strong Python and SQL
- Apache Spark for distributed processing
- Apache Airflow (or similar) for orchestration
- A cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
- Production pipeline operations and monitoring

Required Certifications
- One of: SnowPro Core, Google Professional Data Engineer, or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate

Nice to Have
- dbt
- Kafka / streaming experience
